title: URL shortener
learning_objectives: Propose and revise an inspectable architecture
problem_statement: Design short-link creation and redirection. Clarify privacy, lifetime, collision handling and consistency after creation.

progressive_constraints.title: Resolve a stable mapping
progressive_constraints.description: A client reaches a service and durable mapping authority.

progressive_constraints.title: Identifier space
progressive_constraints.description: State key length and alphabet; compare keyspace with issued IDs while keeping collision policy explicit.

progressive_constraints.title: Hot link
progressive_constraints.description: A single popular link gets most reads. Bound origin load with the stated miss fraction and read budget.

progressive_constraints.title: Deletion and abuse
progressive_constraints.description: A deleted/private link must not remain usable indefinitely through stale caches.

valid_architecture_families.name: Random keys with uniqueness check
valid_architecture_families.description: Use collision detection/retry; a large keyspace alone does not prove no collisions.

valid_architecture_families.name: Allocated ranges or encoded counter
valid_architecture_families.description: Allocate unique identifiers with an explicit privacy and allocation-failover policy.

common_misconceptions: Base62 encoding is not access control.
A large namespace still needs a collision policy.
Caching a redirect changes revocation freshness.

hint_ladder.level_1: Separate key generation from the durable key-to-URL mapping.
hint_ladder.level_2: Compare random keys with allocated counter ranges and explain predictability.
hint_ladder.level_3: 62^7 gives 3521614606208 possible keys, but random issuance still has birthday collisions. Enforce uniqueness or allocate non-overlapping IDs, then state redirect cache and revocation bounds.

consolidation: Identifier allocation, uniqueness, private-link access and revocation are different concerns. Namespace arithmetic is a deterministic estimate, not an abuse or security guarantee.
fresh_transfer_question: How would custom aliases and expiring private links change the creation and redirect paths?
coach_instructions: One clear question at a time. Inspect actual graph and stated assumptions. Do not grade prose by keywords or require a vendor name. Numeric assumptions are learner declarations, not measured performance. Explain when asked, require teach-back, and preserve alternative valid designs. Do not silently edit the diagram.
